scope.purpose: The Ubuntu source packages that correspond to the packages installed in the NVIDIA main, AMD main and Taproom images. Each row names one file of an Ubuntu source package, with its address, size and SHA-256, and the source package and version it belongs to.
scope.licenseDisposition: Source provenance only. The archive set is not a license applicability conclusion or full compliance finding; package-level and linked-library obligations still require review.
scope.note: The AMD main image also installs the binary packages linux-libc-dev (source package linux, 7.0.0-38.38) and rpcsvc-proto (1.4.3-1build1); their rows are tagged amd.

authenticatedMetadata.verification: All signed InRelease files were verified with gpgv against the existing Ubuntu archive keyring. Sources.xz hashes/sizes matched the signed SHA256 sections. Every retained source archive below was then checked against the signed Sources.xz filename, size, and SHA-256.
authenticatedMetadata.retrievalNote: The initial archive host timed out; remaining files were acquired from the official Ubuntu security mirror. Exact signed index hashes and sizes were enforced throughout.

laterAdditions.method: Rows copied from the Sources index of the suite named in each row's sourcePackages entry, after gpgv verified its InRelease with the Ubuntu Archive Automatic Signing Key (2018) and the Sources.xz size and SHA-256 matched the InRelease SHA256 section. The source packages themselves were not downloaded for this step.

howToFetchASourcePackage.byAddress: Download a row's url. The file is the exact one listed, with the size and SHA-256 in the row. Rows of one source package share a pool directory.
howToFetchASourcePackage.withApt: On Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute) with deb-src lines enabled for resolute, resolute-updates and resolute-security, `apt-get source <source>=<version>` downloads and unpacks the same package; the versions are in the rows' sourcePackages entries.
howToFetchASourcePackage.whenAVersionLeftTheArchive: Ubuntu's archive keeps only current versions in its pool. Every published version, including superseded ones, stays on Launchpad at https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/<source>/<version>, which lists the files with their checksums.
